toolchain.local_fallback: Official bundled release C sources compiled locally with Apple Clang; version1.42.1-e1963cd observed.

qualification.source: Use idiomatic Janet, retain every authored helper and exact original-source citations for consulted or adapted implementations.
qualification.correctness: Run the shared independent bounded corpus, validate complete full-size outputs and inspect required work.
qualification.source_size: Expose raw physical rows, bytes/characters, deterministic gzip and pinned BPE metrics; qualify native normalized and formatted counts separately without guessing missing values.
qualification.libraries: Use published general-purpose libraries or ordinary FFI leaves where appropriate; benchmark algorithms and control remain in Janet. No custom native benchmark executor.
qualification.timing: Three fresh complete-process samples per admitted source, including standard source-to-bytecode compilation/loading, VM startup, input, complete work/output and shutdown.
qualification.ratios: Every quantitative observation retains raw seconds and a Mech AOT multiple on the exact equivalent input; absent equivalent denominators remain unavailable.
qualification.contention: Quantitative cohorts require the unchanged shared timing mutex and sequential fresh processes. Untimed development-only runtime/flycheck diagnostics retain their explicit lock exception while the first prebuilt --version process remains in an uninterruptible launch state; no timed cohort starts in that state.
qualification.preservation: Preserve existing sources, source counts, timing observations and baselines.
qualification.admission: Only fully measured, validated and source-qualified implementations enter the plotted catalog.
